tasks.final_text: Shopper's World is an open-air shopping cener in Framingham, Massachuseets. The original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significant as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.

Yesterday I took the wheelie bins out to the curb. I like making it the last chore on Mondays. That way I'm out in the cool night air for a minute, looking at the stars. I pick out the north star, the big dipper, and orion. Its a little too bright in the city to pick out other constellations.
